## Objective

Retire the active human authoring destination while preserving trusted agent workflows and reversible knowledge-safe migration.

## Scope

- Retire active workbench destinations after reader gates
- Verify preserved agent workflows and recovery
- Assess provenance effects and verify reversible migration

## Entry conditions

- Phase 6 contexts pass; source/root retirement file authority is explicit and rollback manifest current.

## Exit criteria

- Normal reader cutover, agent/Template regressions, provenance dispositions and rollback preservation are verified separately.

## Risks

- Shared trusted helpers may be coupled to old service; new valid knowledge/history must never be rolled back.

## TASK-029 - Retire active workbench destinations after reader gates

Apply reviewed normal-launch cutover, old-command deprecation and active frontend asset retirement while preserving shared trusted-authority and agent operations; distribute/adopt the final changed set through existing boundaries.

### Risks

- Legacy initializer resource requirements and trusted-authority callers must have verified current compatibility before active asset retirement.
- Final cutover bytes require another exact owner-mediated Template update and separately authorized root adoption; a prior manifest does not authorize an expanded write set.

### Acceptance criteria

- Current runtime/docs/launchers/distribution no longer offer authoring browser destinations or import old editor/review/advanced frontend modules.
- Every trusted helper caller survives with compatible meaning; shared helpers are preserved or explicitly moved with compatible imports before old service removal.
- Old command emits documented reader deprecation and rejects authoring/grant options; old authoring credentials are not migrated.
- Historical snapshots/proposals/receipts/memory/canonical content survive; exact retired asset deletion and root adoption have recorded authority.

### Planned verification

- Repeat active caller inventory and compare against TASK-001; classify historical matches separately.
- Run direct old-write endpoint failures plus current launch/health and production reader cutover smoke on final installed assets.
- Run fresh updater check/apply/check and root exact adoption verification for final retirement changes only.
- Verify the final current initializer package excludes active old authoring destinations while all historical receipt/edition compatibility tests and preserved trusted-helper callers remain valid.
